name: CDE (Solaris)
framework: Common Desktop Environment 1.x on Solaris 2.6–9 · Motif 1.2/2.1 · dtwm

elements.name: DtIcon
elements.doc: A File Manager / Application Manager icon: picture with its name below; .selected()

elements.name: DtIconButton
elements.doc: A button with its icon above the label (Style Manager)

elements.name: DtTerm
elements.doc: dtterm terminal emulator; lines starting with "$ " are commands

elements.name: DtWindow
elements.doc: A dtwm-framed window inside a Workspace (resize border, window-menu button, minimise/maximise); .variant(.inactive)

elements.name: FrontPanel
elements.doc: The CDE Front Panel along the bottom of the screen

elements.name: FrontPanelControl
elements.doc: A Front Panel control (icon:) with the subpanel arrow above it

elements.name: FrontPanelIcon
elements.doc: A Front Panel control without a subpanel (e.g. the clock)

elements.name: StatusLine
elements.doc: Sunken message/status line at the bottom of a main window

elements.name: SwitchControl
elements.doc: Lock / Exit / busy-light controls beside the workspace buttons

elements.name: Workspace
elements.doc: The workspace backdrop; place windows with .padding and the FrontPanel with .frame(maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .bottom)

elements.name: WorkspaceButton
elements.doc: A workspace button; .selected() for the current workspace; .color(.ws2) etc.

elements.name: WorkspaceSwitch
elements.doc: The workspace switch in the middle of the Front Panel

elements.name: XmCascadeButton
elements.doc: A menu-bar title; the first letter is the mnemonic; .selected() arms it

elements.name: XmComboBox
elements.doc: Combo box: sunken text with an arrow button

elements.name: XmFrame
elements.doc: Etched-in frame with a title on its top edge

elements.name: XmList
elements.doc: List; ListItem children, .selected() uses the select colour

elements.name: XmMainWindow
elements.doc: Main window: menu bar, work area, message line

elements.name: XmMenuBar
elements.doc: Raised menu bar holding XmCascadeButtons / XmPulldownMenus

elements.name: XmMenuItem
elements.doc: A push-button gadget in a menu: shortcut:, checked:, .selected() (armed)

elements.name: XmMessageBox
elements.doc: Message dialog: symbol on the left, message, separator, buttons

elements.name: XmNotebook
elements.sample: XmNotebook() { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: XmOptionMenu
elements.doc: Option menu: raised button with the small raised-bar indicator

elements.name: XmPushButton
elements.doc: Push button with a 2px bevel; .showAsDefault() adds the default ring

elements.name: XmScale
elements.doc: Scale: sunken trough, raised slider with a centre groove, value shown

elements.name: XmScrolledList
elements.doc: List with a vertical scroll bar

elements.name: XmScrolledText
elements.doc: Multi-line text in a scrolled window

elements.name: XmTextField
elements.doc: Single-line text field (sunken, light text background)

elements.name: XmToggleButton
elements.doc: N-of-many toggle: square indicator, filled with the select colour when set

elements.name: Canvas
elements.doc: free-form area; place children with .position(x:y:); grid: .dots|.lines

elements.name: Grid
elements.doc: Grid of GridRow children, or columns: n

elements.name: KanbanCard
elements.doc: title, description:, tags: [..], assignees: [..], due:, comments:, priority:

elements.name: MessageBubble
elements.doc: MessageBubble("Hi", from: .me|.them, author:, time:, status:, reactions: [..])

elements.name: Placeholder
elements.doc: A labelled box for maps, charts, media

elements.name: SelectionRect
elements.doc: a drag-selection rectangle; size with .frame, place with .position

elements.name: Spreadsheet
elements.doc: rows: [[…]], selection: "B2:C4", active:, formula:, sheets: [..], highlight: ["B3": .yellow]

elements.name: TabView
elements.sample: TabView() { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: Tabs
elements.sample: Tabs(["One", "Two", "Three"]) { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: TreeItem
elements.doc: label, systemImage:, folder:, expanded:, selected:, detail:

elements.name: VideoPlayer
elements.doc: poster image, progress: 0…1, time:, duration:, playing:
